statefulset_controller_statefulset_unava.help: Current number of unavailable pods in StatefulSet

storage_count_attachable_volumes_in_use.help: Measure number of volumes in use

taint_eviction_controller_pod_deletion_d.help: Latency, in seconds, between the time when a taint effect has been activated for the Pod and its deletion via TaintEvictionController.

taint_eviction_controller_pod_deletions_.help: Total number of Pods deleted by TaintEvictionController since its start.

ttl_after_finished_controller_job_deleti.help: The time it took to delete the job since it became eligible for deletion

version_info.help: Provides the compatibility version info of the component. The component label is the name of the component, usually kube, but is relevant for aggregated-apiservers.

volume_manager_selinux_container_errors_.help: Number of errors when kubelet cannot compute SELinux context for a container. Kubelet can't start such a Pod then and it will retry, therefore value of this metric may not represent the actual nr. of containers.

volume_manager_selinux_container_warning.help: Number of errors when kubelet cannot compute SELinux context for a container that are ignored. They will become real errors when SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod feature is expanded to all volume access modes.

volume_manager_selinux_pod_context_misma.help: Number of errors when a Pod defines different SELinux contexts for its containers that use the same volume. Kubelet can't start such a Pod then and it will retry, therefore value of this metric may not represent the actual nr. of Pods.

Number of errors when a Pod defines different SELinux contexts for its containers that use the same volume. They are not errors yet, but they will become real errors when SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod feature is expanded to all volume access modes.

volume_manager_selinux_volume_context_mi.help: Number of errors when a Pod uses a volume that is already mounted with a different SELinux context than the Pod needs. Kubelet can't start such a Pod then and it will retry, therefore value of this metric may not represent the actual nr. of Pods.

Number of errors when a Pod uses a volume that is already mounted with a different SELinux context than the Pod needs. They are not errors yet, but they will become real errors when SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod feature is expanded to all volume access modes.

volume_manager_selinux_volumes_admitted_.help: Number of volumes whose SELinux context was fine and will be mounted with mount -o context option.

volume_manager_total_volumes.help: Number of volumes in Volume Manager

volume_operation_total_seconds.help: Storage operation end to end duration in seconds

watch_cache_capacity.help: Total capacity of watch cache broken by resource type.

watch_cache_capacity_decrease_total.help: Total number of watch cache capacity decrease events broken by resource type.

watch_cache_capacity_increase_total.help: Total number of watch cache capacity increase events broken by resource type.

workqueue_adds_total.help: Total number of adds handled by workqueue

workqueue_longest_running_processor_seco.help: How many seconds has the longest running processor for workqueue been running.

workqueue_queue_duration_seconds.help: How long in seconds an item stays in workqueue before being requested.

workqueue_retries_total.help: Total number of retries handled by workqueue

workqueue_unfinished_work_seconds.help: How many seconds of work has done that is in progress and hasn't been observed by work_duration. Large values indicate stuck threads. One can deduce the number of stuck threads by observing the rate at which this increases.

workqueue_work_duration_seconds.help: How long in seconds processing an item from workqueue takes.
